title: 退貨、換貨不吃虧
subtitle: 12 句英文，東西壞了也不怕

lines.say: Hi… em… this kettle… it doesn't… I want my money back. Now.
lines.zh: 嗨……呃……這個水壺……它不……我要退錢。馬上。

lines.say: Do you have a receipt? Was it opened? What exactly is wrong with it?
lines.zh: 你有收據嗎？拆開過嗎？到底哪裡有問題？

lines.say: I walked in angry, and walked out with nothing. Because I couldn't answer three simple questions.
lines.zh: 我氣沖沖走進去，結果什麼都沒拿到，因為我答不出三個簡單的問題。

lines.say: Returning something is easy, if you say what happened, what you want, and why you're right.
lines.zh: 退貨其實很簡單，只要說清楚發生什麼、你要什麼、為什麼你有道理。

board.cta: 退貨、換貨不吃虧・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for returning things in a shop.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你在店裡退換貨的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for returning things in a shop.

lines.say: Explaining the problem, asking for what you want, handling a no, and returning a gift with no receipt.
lines.zh: 說明問題、提出要求、被拒絕時怎麼辦，還有沒收據的禮物怎麼退。

lines.say: Part one: explain the problem.
lines.zh: 第一段：說明問題。

lines.say: Calm and clear wins every time. Shouting gets you nowhere.
lines.zh: 冷靜清楚每次都贏，大吼大叫什麼都拿不到。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I'd like to return this, please. It stopped working after two days.
scenes.meaning: 我想退這個，它用兩天就壞了
scenes.note: stopped working ＝ 不能用了、壞了

lines.say: I'd like to return this, please. It stopped working after two days.
Start with what you want, then the problem. Two short sentences.
lines.zh: 先說你要什麼，再說問題。兩句短句就好。

lines.say: Stopped working is perfect for anything electrical. No need for technical words.
lines.zh: stopped working 適用所有電器，不需要專業字。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd like to return this, please. It stopped working after two days.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: I bought it here last Saturday. Here's the receipt.
scenes.meaning: 我上週六在這裡買的，這是收據
scenes.note: Here's the receipt ＝ 這是收據

lines.say: Then show them it's from their shop.
lines.zh: 接著證明是在他們店裡買的。

lines.say: I bought it here last Saturday. Here's the receipt.
When and where. That's the first thing staff need to know.
lines.zh: 時間和地點，這是店員第一個需要知道的。

lines.say: And hand over the receipt while you say it. Very professional.
lines.zh: 邊說邊遞上收據，非常專業。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I bought it here last Saturday. Here's the receipt.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: It was like this when I opened the box.
scenes.meaning: 我一打開盒子就是這樣了
scenes.note: It was like this ＝ 本來就是這樣

lines.say: And make it clear it wasn't your fault.
lines.zh: 再講清楚不是你弄壞的。

lines.say: It was like this when I opened the box.
It was like this means: I didn't break it. It came broken.
lines.zh: It was like this 意思是：不是我弄壞的，買來就壞了。

lines.say: Point at the problem as you say it.
lines.zh: 說的時候指著問題的地方。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It was like this when I opened the box.

scenes.title: Ask
scenes.sub: 提出要求：退錢、換貨還是保固

lines.say: Part two: ask for what you want.
lines.zh: 第二段：提出你要的。

lines.say: Don't wait for them to decide. Tell them which option you'd like.
lines.zh: 不要等對方決定，直接說你想要哪個選項。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Would I be able to get a refund rather than an exchange?
scenes.meaning: 我可以退錢，而不是換貨嗎？

lines.say: Would I be able to get a refund rather than an exchange?
A refund is your money back. An exchange is a new one of the same thing.
lines.zh: refund 是退錢，exchange 是換一個新的。

lines.say: Would I be able to is polite but clear. You're asking, but you know what you want.
lines.zh: Would I be able to 禮貌又清楚，是在問，但你知道自己要什麼。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Would I be able to get a refund rather than an exchange?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: If you don't have another one in stock, could I get store credit?
scenes.meaning: 如果沒有現貨，可以給我店內購物金嗎？
scenes.note: in stock ＝ 有現貨；store credit ＝ 購物金

lines.say: Then have a plan B ready.
lines.zh: 接著準備好 B 計畫。

lines.say: If you don't have another one in stock, could I get store credit?
In stock means the shop has it right now.
lines.zh: in stock 是店裡現在有貨。

lines.say: Store credit is money you can only spend in that shop. Better than nothing!
lines.zh: store credit 是只能在那家店用的錢。總比沒有好！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: If you don't have another one in stock, could I get store credit?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: It's only eight months old. Is it still under warranty?
scenes.meaning: 才買八個月，還在保固期內嗎？

lines.say: And for bigger things, ask about the warranty.
lines.zh: 比較貴的東西，記得問保固。

lines.say: It's only eight months old. Is it still under warranty?
Under warranty means they must repair or replace it for free.
lines.zh: under warranty 是他們必須免費修理或更換。

lines.say: Most electrical things have at least one year. Always ask!
lines.zh: 大部分電器至少一年保固。一定要問！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It's only eight months old. Is it still under warranty?
Let's go back and try again.
lines.zh: 我們回去再試一次。

lines.say: Hi. I'd like to return this, please. It stopped working after two days.
lines.zh: 嗨，我想退這個，它用兩天就壞了。

lines.say: Oh no, sorry to hear that. When did you buy it?
lines.zh: 喔不，很抱歉。你什麼時候買的？

lines.say: I bought it here last Saturday. Here's the receipt. It was like this when I opened the box.
lines.zh: 我上週六在這裡買的，這是收據。我一打開盒子就是這樣了。

lines.say: Right. I can give you a new one, or…
lines.zh: 好的，我可以換一個新的給你，或者……

lines.say: Would I be able to get a refund rather than an exchange?
lines.zh: 我可以退錢，而不是換貨嗎？

lines.say: Clear and calm. Now, what if she says no?
lines.zh: 清楚又冷靜。那如果她說不行呢？

scenes.title: When they say no
scenes.sub: 被拒絕時：有禮貌地堅持

lines.say: Part three: when the answer is no.
lines.zh: 第三段：當對方說不行。

lines.say: Don't give up, and don't get angry. Stay polite, and stay firm.
lines.zh: 不要放棄，也不要生氣。保持禮貌，但要堅定。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: I understand it's your policy, but it's faulty, not just unwanted.
scenes.meaning: 我理解這是你們的規定，但它是壞的，不是我不想要

lines.say: I understand it's your policy, but it's faulty, not just unwanted.
I understand, but shows you're listening, and then you push back.
lines.zh: I understand, but 表示你有在聽，然後再反駁。

lines.say: Faulty is the key word. A faulty item is very different from changing your mind.
lines.zh: faulty 是關鍵字。東西壞了跟你改變心意是完全不同的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I understand it's your policy, but it's faulty, not just unwanted.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: As far as I know, I'm entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund.
scenes.meaning: 據我所知，我有權要求修理、換新或退款
scenes.note: be entitled to ＝ 有權得到

lines.say: Then mention your rights. Gently.
lines.zh: 接著溫和地提到你的權利。

lines.say: As far as I know, I'm entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund.
In Ireland and the EU, if something is faulty, you have these rights by law.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭和歐盟，東西有瑕疵，法律保障你這些權利。

lines.say: As far as I know makes it sound less aggressive. You're not a lawyer, you're just informed.
lines.zh: As far as I know 讓語氣沒那麼衝，你不是律師，只是有做功課。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: As far as I know, I'm entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Is there a manager on duty I could have a word with?
scenes.meaning: 現在有值班的主管可以讓我談一下嗎？
scenes.note: have a word with ＝ 跟……談一下

lines.say: And if you're still stuck, go one step up.
lines.zh: 如果還是卡住，就往上找一層。

lines.say: Is there a manager on duty I could have a word with?
On duty means working right now. Have a word with means have a short talk.
lines.zh: on duty 是正在值班，have a word with 是談一下。

lines.say: Much better than: get me your manager!
lines.zh: 比「叫你們經理出來！」好太多了。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there a manager on duty I could have a word with?

scenes.title: No receipt
scenes.sub: 沒收據的禮物：照樣能處理

lines.say: Part four: returning a gift, with no receipt.
lines.zh: 第四段：沒有收據的禮物怎麼退。

lines.say: It's harder, but it's often possible. You just need the right words.
lines.zh: 比較難，但常常做得到，只要用對的話。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: It was a present, so I only have the gift receipt.
scenes.meaning: 這是別人送的，所以我只有禮物收據
scenes.note: gift receipt ＝ 禮物收據（不顯示價格）

lines.say: It was a present, so I only have the gift receipt.
A gift receipt shows what was bought, but not the price.
lines.zh: gift receipt 顯示買了什麼，但不顯示價格。

lines.say: Most shops will give you an exchange or store credit with one.
lines.zh: 大部分店家看到它會讓你換貨或給購物金。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It was a present, so I only have the gift receipt.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I paid by card, so it should show up on your system.
scenes.meaning: 我是刷卡付的，所以你們系統應該查得到

lines.say: And if you paid by card, there's another way.
lines.zh: 如果你是刷卡，還有另一個辦法。

lines.say: I paid by card, so it should show up on your system.
Show up means appear. The shop can search for the payment.
lines.zh: show up 是出現，店家可以查這筆付款。

lines.say: No paper receipt? Your bank card is your receipt.
lines.zh: 沒有紙本收據？你的卡就是收據。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I paid by card, so it should show up on your system.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate you going out of your way.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝你的耐心，真的很感謝你特別幫忙
scenes.note: go out of your way ＝ 特地多花力氣幫忙

lines.say: And always end with this.
lines.zh: 最後一定要用這句收尾。

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate you going out of your way.
Going out of your way means doing more than you have to.
lines.zh: go out of your way 是做得比該做的還多。

lines.say: Staff remember nice customers. Next time, they'll help you even faster.
lines.zh: 店員會記得好客人，下次會更快幫你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate you going out of your way.
I understand it's your policy, but it's faulty, not just unwanted.
lines.zh: 我理解這是你們的規定，但它是壞的，不是我不想要。

lines.say: Hmm, I'll need to check with my manager.
lines.zh: 嗯，我需要問一下我的主管。

lines.say: No problem. As far as I know, I'm entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund.
lines.zh: 沒問題。據我所知，我有權要求修理、換新或退款。

lines.say: You're right. I'll do the refund for you now.
lines.zh: 你說得對，我現在幫你退款。

lines.say: Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate you going out of your way.
lines.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，真的很感謝你特別幫忙。

lines.say: Money back, and everyone's still smiling.
lines.zh: 錢退回來了，大家都還笑著。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：東西壞了怎麼說

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish phrases you'll hear at the counter.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！櫃檯常聽到的兩句愛爾蘭話。

lines.say: When something is completely broken, Irish people say this.
lines.zh: 東西完全壞掉時，愛爾蘭人會這樣說。

lines.say: It's banjaxed.
Banjaxed means broken beyond hope. Your kettle, your phone, your back after moving house.
lines.zh: banjaxed 是壞到沒救。你的水壺、手機，或搬家後的腰。

lines.say: And when someone helps you, this is the Irish thank you.
lines.zh: 有人幫你時，這是愛爾蘭式的謝謝。

lines.say: Thanks a million!
A million thanks. Very warm, very Irish. You'll hear it ten times a day.
lines.zh: 一百萬個謝謝，很溫暖，很愛爾蘭。你一天會聽到十次。

lines.say: Thanks a million!
Now the whole return, from start to finish. Say my lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段退貨從頭到尾演一遍。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Hi. I'd like to return this, please. It's banjaxed. It was like this when I opened the box.
lines.zh: 嗨，我想退這個，它完全壞了。我一打開盒子就是這樣了。

lines.say: Do you have the receipt?
lines.zh: 你有收據嗎？

lines.say: It was a present, so I only have the gift receipt. But my friend paid by card, so it should show up on your system.
lines.zh: 這是別人送的，所以我只有禮物收據。但我朋友是刷卡付的，所以你們系統應該查得到。

lines.say: Let me check… Yes, there it is.
lines.zh: 我查一下……有，找到了。

lines.say: If you don't have another one in stock, could I get store credit?
lines.zh: 如果沒有現貨，可以給我店內購物金嗎？

lines.say: Of course. Here you go.
lines.zh: 當然，給你。

lines.say: Thanks a million!
lines.zh: 太感謝了！

items: I'd like to return this, please. It stopped working after two days.
I bought it here last Saturday. Here's the receipt.
It was like this when I opened the box.
Would I be able to get a refund rather than an exchange?
If you don't have another one in stock, could I get store credit?
It's only eight months old. Is it still under warranty?
I understand it's your policy, but it's faulty, not just unwanted.
As far as I know, I'm entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund.
Is there a manager on duty I could have a word with?
It was a present, so I only have the gift receipt.
I paid by card, so it should show up on your system.
Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate you going out of your way.

lines.say: Brilliant! Calm, clear, and polite but firm.
lines.zh: 太棒了！冷靜、清楚，有禮貌又堅定。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them for the next time something breaks.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖存起來，下次東西壞了用得到。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: And keep your receipts! See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 還有，收據要留好！下一課見，Bye！
